parts.title: Getting Ready
parts.text: It was bedtime at Grandma’s house. Elena let out a big **yawn**. Jamal brushed his teeth. Ivy put on her soft pajamas. Grandma turned the lamp low to make the room **dim**.

parts.title: Tucked In
parts.text: Grandma began to **tuck** the blankets around each child. Elena wanted to **cuddle** her teddy bear. Outside, the stars began to **twinkle**. Grandma sang a **lullaby** in her soft voice. “**Hush** now, my little ones,” she said.

parts.title: Sleepy Sounds
parts.text: The house grew **silent**. Elena had taken a **nap** that afternoon, but now she felt sleepy again. Down the hall, Grandpa began to **snore**, and the children giggled. Ivy’s bed felt like a **cradle** that rocked her. Everything was **peaceful**.

parts.title: Good Night
parts.text: Grandma kissed each child on the head. The room was quiet. Morning would come soon, bright and warm.

definitions.meaning1: To open your mouth wide when you are tired. Example: I yawn when I am sleepy.
definitions.meaning2: A big breath with an open mouth when you are tired. Example: He let out a big yawn.
definitions.studentChallenge: Dad began to ___ and rub his eyes.

definitions.meaning1: To hold someone close in a warm, loving way. Example: I cuddle my cat on the couch.
definitions.meaning2: A warm hug. Example: Give me a cuddle.
definitions.studentChallenge: The baby loves to ___ with her mom.

definitions.meaning1: A soft song that helps a baby fall asleep. Example: Mom sang a lullaby to the baby.
To make a loud sound when you breathe in your sleep. Example: My dad can snore very loudly.
definitions.meaning2: The sound of breathing in sleep. Example: We heard a snore from the next room.
definitions.studentChallenge: The big dog will ___ in his sleep.

definitions.meaning1: To shine with little blinking lights. Example: The stars twinkle at night.
definitions.meaning2: A small, blinking light. Example: I saw a twinkle in the sky.

definitions.meaning1: To be quiet, or to tell someone to be quiet. Example: Hush, the baby is sleeping.
definitions.meaning2: A time of quiet. Example: A hush fell over the room.
definitions.studentChallenge: Please ___ so the baby can sleep.

definitions.meaning1: A small bed for a baby that rocks. Example: The baby slept in the cradle.
definitions.meaning2: To hold gently in your arms. Example: I cradle my teddy bear.
definitions.studentChallenge: The baby slept in a rocking ___.

definitions.meaning1: Not very bright. Example: The room was dim at night.
definitions.meaning2: To make less bright. Example: Please dim the lights.
definitions.studentChallenge: A ___ light helps me fall asleep.

definitions.meaning1: To fold in the edges of a blanket so someone is snug. Example: Mom will tuck me in bed.
definitions.meaning2: To put something in neatly. Example: I tuck my shirt into my pants.
definitions.studentChallenge: Please ___ the blanket under your feet.

definitions.meaning1: A short sleep in the day. Example: The baby takes a nap after lunch.
definitions.meaning2: To sleep for a short time. Example: I will nap on the couch.
definitions.studentChallenge: My little brother takes a ___ after lunch.

definitions.meaning1: Making no sound at all. Example: The room was silent.
Calm and quiet, with no worry. Example: The lake was peaceful at sunset.
